title: ChangesPage
description: One page of the change feed. Paginated: while has_more is true, request the next page with cursor=next_cursor right away; when it is false, store next_cursor and poll later (or on a changes.available webhook). See docs/protocol.md section 2.1 (Pagination).

changes.description: This page's entries in seq order; possibly fewer than limit, or none, even when has_more is true.

next_cursor.description: Always present. Pass it as cursor on the next call: immediately when has_more is true, on the next poll otherwise. Never parse it.

has_more.description: True when more entries are available right now: keep paging. False: you are up to date.

phase.description: snapshot: replaying current state after a cursor-less start; live: incremental changes. The first page with phase=live after a snapshot means the snapshot is complete.
